fidelityReview.notes: Passed for the complete detailed polygonal exterior: the documented 20.5 m stepped foundation, ten-pier arcade, 19.86 m platform, 7.03 m cupola, 26.57 m figure and sword, shield, helmet, cape and defeated Roman symbols are represented.
